Java reflection and hooks

Resolve Telegram classes and exact signatures before registering a hook.

Inspect host classes

Use java.jclass or the helpers in hook_utils to inspect classes and declared members. Telegram Java names and overloads can change between builds.

Register ART hooks

Declare hooks.raw, the relevant build ranges, and hook_targets in the BYgram manifest. The host verifies the declared signatures and probes the backend before activating the plugin. The generated Java proxies described in Managed Java proxies use a separate DexMaker bridge.
